messages:
maria: opened PR to harmonize SDK snippets for streaming + pagination across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

oliver: nice. main asks: show cursor save/restore, abort/cancel example, and use `cursor` name everywhere. keep each snippet <=10 lines.

anya: I can take Python + Go. quick Q: prefer `cursor: null` or `cursor: ''` in examples?

sam: docs convention is `null` in TS, empty string in Go, and `None` in Python when explicit. add a one-liner note that cursor is opaque.

maria: draft snippets below, very compact for the docs block. feedback?

maria: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# resume using saved cursor
for chunk in client.stream('gpt-medium', prompt='resume example', max_tokens=80, cursor=None):
    print(chunk.text)
```

maria: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController(); setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),1500)
for await (const p of client.stream('gpt-medium',{prompt:'resume example',maxTokens:80,cursor:null,signal:ac.signal})) console.log(p.text)
```

maria: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()
iter := client.Stream(ctx, "gpt-medium", redwood.StreamOpts{Prompt:"resume example", MaxTokens:80, Cursor:""})
for iter.Next() { fmt.Println(iter.Current().Text) }
```

ci-bot: lint: please use `max_tokens` in Python snippet; checked Go imports OK.

anya: will switch the param name and add the opaque-cursor note. also adding a simple smoke job to CI that runs these examples behind an env guard.

sam: thanks. once CI smoke passes i'll approve and merge. :thumbsup:
